scope: All 13 hospital/clinic records mapped in the reviewed Greater Malé planning baseline.

policy.defaultGeneralCare: Include only reviewed operatingStatus=open, careScope=general and existing verified map records; retain closed, specialist and unverified records in the inspectable catalogue.
policy.statusMeaning: Open denotes current registration/provider/operator evidence on review date. It does not certify opening hours on a selected departure date, capacity, affordability, disability access, or exact entrances.
policy.absenceRule: Missing registry/provider/source evidence is unverified, never proof of closure.
policy.coordinateRule: Preserve mapped coordinates unless an independently evidenced replacement location is established. Operator map pin agreement corroborates approximate location, not a surveyed entrance.

coverageGaps.name: Dhamanaveshi
coverageGaps.statusNote: Not among the 13 mapped baseline healthcare destinations. June 2026 secondary reports consistently describe temporary relocation to UPHC Maafannu and GP/other Hulhumalé services during renovation. A primary June notice and current replacement coordinates were not recovered. February 2026 Ministry charter predates this event and cannot confirm continued operation at the old Majeedhee Magu building. Do not add or move a point on this evidence alone.

coverageGaps.name: Vilimalé Hospital
coverageGaps.statusNote: Operator network lists hospital; current baseline explicitly lacks a verified geocoded point. This facility audit does not invent a centroid or count access to it.

limitations: Review is a desk audit of public primary sources, not a site visit or telephone confirmation.
The Ministry HEMS class list includes explicit closed flags; practitioners counts are not measured capacity and a zero displayed count does not prove closure.
Aasandha empanelment and suspension lists cover insurance relationships, not the physical opening of every service at a site.
Most points remain OSM node/building centroids. No facility has a certified accessible street entrance in this bundle.
All healthcare destination availability remains untimed: current operating status does not establish whether an outpatient clinic is open at a scenario departure time.
No exact duplicate healthcare IDs/names occur among these 13 records. IGMH and Dharumavantha are distinct registered buildings in a shared campus, not independently additive capacity.
